description: Crimson Hexagon (now Brandwatch Consumer Research) is an AI-powered consumer intelligence platform that analyses social media, news, and review data at massive scale. Brand teams and market researchers use it to understand consumer perception and track campaign impact in real time.
name: Crimson Hexagon

description: Cursor is an AI-first code editor — a fork of VS Code — that puts GPT-4 and Claude directly into the editing experience. It can rewrite entire functions from a description, explain unfamiliar codebases, generate tests, and apply multi-file edits with a single instruction. Developers describe it as the closest thing to having a senior engineer pair-programming with you full time.
name: Cursor

description: Cursor Composer is the multi-file code generation feature inside the Cursor editor that can create, edit, and refactor code across an entire project with a single instruction. Unlike standard autocomplete or single-file chat, Composer understands the full project structure and can create new files, modify existing ones, update imports, and run terminal commands as part of completing a task. Its ability to handle complex, cross-file changes has made it the feature that defines Cursor's advantage over simpler AI coding tools.
name: Cursor Composer

description: D-ID is an AI video platform that animates still photos into talking, expressive video presenters. You upload a portrait and provide a script or audio track, and D-ID generates a realistic talking-head video in minutes. It's used for e-learning content, corporate communications, social media, and multilingual training videos at a fraction of traditional video production costs.
name: D-ID

description: Dark Sky (acquired by Apple) pioneered hyperlocal, minute-by-minute precipitation forecasting using radar analysis and machine learning. Its trademark feature was the ability to tell you exactly when rain would start at your specific location, down to the minute. The technology now powers weather features in iOS.
name: Dark Sky

description: DataRobot is an automated machine learning platform that allows data teams to build, deploy, and monitor predictive models without deep ML expertise. It automates the most time-consuming steps — feature engineering, model selection, and hyperparameter tuning — while giving data scientists full control over every decision. Enterprises use DataRobot to operationalise AI across risk, marketing, operations, and supply chain.
name: DataRobot

description: DeepL is widely regarded as the most accurate AI translation service available, producing natural-sounding translations that preserve tone and nuance better than competitors. It supports 33 languages and offers a document translation feature that maintains the original formatting. DeepL Pro is popular with businesses and translators who need consistent quality for sensitive or technical content.
name: DeepL

description: Descript is an audio and video editor that turns recordings into editable text documents — you edit the media by editing the words. Its AI features include Overdub (voice cloning for corrections), Studio Sound (one-click noise removal), and automatic filler-word removal. Podcasters, YouTubers, and online course creators use it to slash post-production time.
name: Descript

description: Descript is an audio and video editor that turns recordings into editable text documents — you edit the media by editing the words. Its AI features include Overdub (voice cloning for corrections), Studio Sound (one-click noise removal), and automatic filler-word removal. name: Descript

Its AI features include Overdub (voice cloning for corrections), Studio Sound (one-click noise removal), and automatic filler-word removal. Podcasters, YouTubers, and online course creators use it to slash post-production time.
name: Descript

description: Dify is an open-source LLM application development platform that lets teams build AI workflows, RAG pipelines, agents, and chatbots through a visual interface — without writing infrastructure code. It supports every major model provider, has a built-in vector database, and can be self-hosted for full data control. Product teams use it to ship AI features quickly, while developers use its API to integrate Dify workflows into existing applications. It has become one of the most popular AI app builders in the open-source community.
name: Dify

description: DoNotPay is an AI-powered consumer advocacy app — sometimes called 'the world's first robot lawyer' — that helps individuals fight bureaucratic hurdles without hiring a lawyer. It can cancel subscriptions, contest parking tickets, write demand letters, claim refunds, and identify hidden class-action settlements. Millions of users have used it to recover money and assert consumer rights.
name: DoNotPay

description: Duolingo is the world's most popular language learning app, teaching 40+ languages through short, gamified lessons that make daily practice habit-forming. Its AI personalises the lesson difficulty and review schedule based on what you're forgetting, and Duolingo Max introduces AI conversation practice and explanation features powered by GPT-4. Over 500 million people have used it to learn a new language.
name: Duolingo

description: Durable is an AI website builder that creates a complete, designed website for a small business in under 30 seconds from a short description. It generates copy, selects images, and structures pages tailored to the business type, then lets you edit everything with a chat interface. Freelancers and local businesses use it to have a professional online presence without any design or coding skills.
name: Durable

description: Elai.io is an AI video generation platform that turns text scripts into polished presenter videos using realistic AI avatars. You choose from dozens of avatars, write or paste your script, and get a professional-quality video in minutes — without cameras, studios, or recording. It's widely used for corporate training, onboarding, and multilingual marketing content.
name: Elai.io

description: ElevenLabs is the leading AI voice synthesis platform, capable of generating ultra-realistic speech in 29 languages with precise control over tone, pacing, and emotion. Its voice cloning feature can replicate a person's voice from a few minutes of audio. Audiobook publishers, game studios, content creators, and accessibility app developers use ElevenLabs as the gold standard for AI-generated voice.
name: ElevenLabs

description: ElevenLabs is the leading AI voice synthesis platform, capable of generating ultra-realistic speech in 29 languages with precise control over tone, pacing, and emotion. Its voice cloning feature can replicate a person's voice from a few minutes of audio. Audiobook publishers, game studios, content creators, and accessibility app developers use ElevenLabs as the gold standard for AI-generated voice.
name: ElevenLabs

description: ElevenLabs Sound Effects is a dedicated tool for generating custom audio effects from text descriptions — "gravel footsteps on a rainy night", "futuristic laser blast with echo", "cheerful cartoon bounce". The AI synthesises unique, royalty-free audio suited for games, films, podcasts, and app development. Unlike stock libraries, every sound is unique and generated on demand to match the creator's exact specification. It is part of ElevenLabs' broader push beyond voice synthesis into a full AI audio platform.
name: ElevenLabs Sound Effects

description: Elicit is an AI research assistant that automates the most tedious parts of literature review — finding relevant papers, extracting key data points, and summarising findings across hundreds of studies. Researchers upload their research question and Elicit returns a structured table of evidence from the scientific literature. It's particularly valued in medicine, policy research, and systematic review workflows.
name: Elicit

description: Elicit is an AI research assistant that automates the most tedious parts of literature review — finding relevant papers, extracting key data points, and summarising findings across hundreds of studies. Researchers upload their research question and Elicit returns a structured table of evidence from the scientific literature. It's particularly valued in medicine, policy research, and systematic review workflows.
name: Elicit

description: FarmLogs (now Bushel Farm) is a farm management and record-keeping platform that centralises field activities, input usage, and yield data in one place. Its AI-powered crop monitoring tracks crop health from satellite imagery and alerts farmers to stress areas before they're visible from the tractor. Small and mid-sized row crop farmers use it to make faster, better-informed agronomic decisions.
name: FarmLogs

description: Fashwell is a visual AI platform for fashion and retail that enables visual search, product tagging, and personalised recommendations from images. Retailers integrate its API to let shoppers find products by uploading a photo, and to automatically tag catalogue images with attributes like colour, style, and occasion. It powers search and discovery on major European fashion e-commerce platforms.
name: Fashwell

description: Fathom is an AI meeting assistant for Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams that records, transcribes, and instantly generates a shareable summary with action items. It highlights the most important moments of each call and syncs key takeaways to your CRM automatically. Sales teams and managers use it to capture every commitment without having to take notes during a conversation.
name: Fathom

description: Figma is the dominant collaborative design tool used by product teams worldwide for UI/UX design, prototyping, and design system management. Its AI features — including First Draft (layout generation), Auto Layout, and plugin-based AI tools — accelerate the path from idea to interactive prototype. Designers, product managers, and engineers all work inside Figma, making it the single source of design truth.
name: Figma

description: Fireflies.ai is an AI meeting intelligence platform that joins your calls as a silent participant, records and transcribes everything, and delivers searchable, summarised notes. Its AI surfaces key topics, questions, and sentiment, and integrates with Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, and 50+ other tools to automatically log meeting outcomes. Remote and hybrid teams use it to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
name: Fireflies.ai

description: Fireworks AI is a cloud inference platform that delivers some of the fastest and most cost-effective API access to open-source models including Llama, Mixtral, Qwen, and Stable Diffusion. Its FireFunction models are fine-tuned specifically for reliable JSON output and tool-calling, making them popular for structured extraction and agentic tasks where output format matters. Fireworks uses custom CUDA kernels and batching optimisations to achieve throughput that significantly undercuts larger cloud providers on both speed and cost.
name: Fireworks AI

description: Flowise is an open-source, low-code tool for visually building LangChain and LlamaIndex-based AI applications. Users drag and drop nodes — for models, vector stores, memory, tools, and APIs — to construct chatbots, RAG pipelines, and AI agents without writing backend code. Self-hostable and highly extensible, it is popular with developers who want the power of LangChain without the complexity of building every integration from scratch. The Flowise marketplace provides pre-built templates for common use cases.
name: Flowise

description: FlutterFlow is a visual app builder on top of Google's Flutter framework, letting teams design and ship production-grade iOS, Android, and web apps without writing most of the code. Its AI assistant can generate full pages from a text description and suggests components as you build. It's popular with agencies and startups that need native-quality apps but don't have a mobile dev on staff.
name: FlutterFlow

description: Formula Bot is an AI tool that generates Excel and Google Sheets formulas from a plain-English description of what you want to calculate. You type something like 'sum all cells in column B where column A says Approved' and Formula Bot produces the correct formula instantly. It also explains existing formulas in plain language, making it invaluable for non-technical spreadsheet users.
name: Formula Bot

description: Foursquare is a location intelligence company whose data powers local search, place recommendations, and foot-traffic analytics for millions of apps and businesses. Its AI platform helps retailers understand where customers come from, what competitors they visit, and which locations perform best. Developers access Foursquare's Places API to add local search and venue data to their own products.
name: Foursquare

description: Framer is a website builder aimed at designers who want pixel-perfect results without engineering support. Its AI site generator creates a full design from a prompt, and the visual editor gives designers fine control over animations, responsive breakpoints, and interactions. Agencies and design-led startups use Framer for marketing sites that genuinely stand out.
name: Framer

description: Frase is an AI SEO platform that helps content teams research, brief, and optimise articles to rank in Google. It analyses the top-ranking pages for any target keyword and generates a detailed content brief showing the topics, headers, and questions you need to cover. Writers and SEO managers use it to cut research time and build content that's structurally aligned with what Google rewards.
name: Frase

description: Freepik has integrated powerful AI image generation directly into its platform, which already serves over 50 million designers and creatives monthly. Its AI Image Generator (powered by Mystic and Flux models), AI Photo Editor, and Pikaso real-time sketch-to-image tool let users generate and edit images without leaving the Freepik workflow. Because it's embedded in a platform where users already source stock imagery, AI generation has seen rapid adoption — over 100 million AI images generated in its first year.
name: Freepik AI

description: Freshdesk is a cloud-based customer support platform that centralises tickets from email, chat, phone, and social media into one shared inbox. Its Freddy AI capabilities automate ticket classification and routing, suggest responses from your knowledge base, and flag customers who are at risk of churning. Thousands of support teams use Freshdesk to handle higher ticket volumes without proportionally growing headcount.
name: Freshdesk

description: Gamma is an AI-native presentation and document tool that generates a complete, designed deck from a topic or outline in seconds. Rather than starting from a blank slide, you describe what you need and Gamma produces structured content you can refine — including text, images, charts, and embeds. It's become a favourite for people who need compelling presentations quickly but don't enjoy building them in PowerPoint.
name: Gamma

description: Gemini is Google's AI assistant, integrated into Search, Gmail, Docs, and Android devices. It answers questions with real-time web grounding, helps draft and refine writing, analyses uploaded images and documents, and assists with coding. Gemini Advanced (powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro) is available as part of Google One and competes directly with ChatGPT Plus for everyday AI tasks.
name: Gemini

description: Gemini Advanced is Google's premium AI assistant tier, powered by the Gemini Ultra model — Google's most capable AI for complex reasoning, coding, and multimodal analysis. Available as part of the Google One AI Premium plan, it integrates deeply with Gmail, Docs, Drive, and other Google Workspace apps through Gemini in Workspace. Subscribers get priority access to new features, 2TB of storage, and the ability to create custom Gems (personalised AI assistants). It is Google's primary offering to compete with ChatGPT Plus and Claude Pro.
name: Gemini Advanced

description: Gemini in Workspace embeds Google's AI directly into Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Meet for over 3 billion users. In Gmail it drafts and summarises emails. In Docs it writes, rewrites, and proofreads. In Sheets it generates formulas and analyses data. In Meet it provides real-time AI captions, summaries, and action items. Available as part of Google Workspace Business and Enterprise plans, it represents one of the largest-scale AI deployments in the world, bringing AI assistance to the tools billions of people use for work daily.
name: Gemini in Workspace

description: Gemini 2.0 is Google DeepMind's frontier AI model family, with Gemini 2.5 Pro offering a 1 million-token context window and native support for text, images, audio, video, and code in a single model. Its Deep Research feature autonomously browses the web and synthesises multi-source reports, and its thinking mode enables transparent step-by-step reasoning. Available through Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, and embedded across Google's product suite.
name: Gemini 2.0

description: Gemma is Google DeepMind's family of open-weight language models, designed to be lightweight enough to run on laptops and edge devices while delivering strong performance on reasoning, coding, and conversation. The Gemma 2 and Gemma 3 releases — available in 2B, 9B, and 27B variants — have become popular choices for developers who want Google-quality AI without the API costs. Gemma models are freely downloadable from Hugging Face and run natively in Ollama and LM Studio.
name: Gemma

description: Runway Gen-3 Alpha is Runway's most advanced video generation model, producing highly consistent, cinematic video clips up to 10 seconds long with superior motion quality and photorealism compared to its predecessors. It supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video generation and integrates directly into Runway's full creative suite. Professional filmmakers and VFX studios use it for pre-visualisation, b-roll generation, and experimental visual storytelling.
name: Runway Gen-3 Alpha

description: GitHub Copilot is an AI pair programmer developed by GitHub and OpenAI that suggests code completions, entire functions, and boilerplate inline as you type. It understands the context of your file and project, making suggestions that fit your coding style. With over 1.8 million paid subscribers, it's the most widely adopted AI coding assistant across all major languages and editors.
name: GitHub Copilot

description: GitHub Copilot Workspace is an AI-native development environment that takes a GitHub Issue and autonomously turns it into a specification, implementation plan, and set of code changes — all before the developer writes a line. The developer reviews the plan, edits the steps, then lets Copilot generate the code across multiple files. It runs in the browser with a built-in terminal for tests, making it possible to go from bug report to reviewed PR entirely in the browser. It represents GitHub's vision of AI as a full development collaborator, not just an autocomplete tool.
name: GitHub Copilot Workspace

description: Glassdoor is a job search and company review platform where current and former employees post candid ratings on salary, culture, management, and interview experiences. Its AI surfaces personalised job recommendations based on your profile, and the salary data lets candidates negotiate from a position of knowledge. Job seekers use it to see through the polished surface of company career pages.
name: Glassdoor

description: Glean is an enterprise AI platform that connects to all the tools a company uses — Slack, Confluence, Jira, Google Drive, Salesforce, GitHub, and 100+ others — and provides a unified AI search and assistant that understands company-specific knowledge. Employees can ask questions like 'what did the design team decide about the checkout flow?' and Glean retrieves the relevant Slack threads, Figma files, and documents with full context. Its AI assistant can then synthesise answers from across all sources, making it one of the most widely deployed enterprise AI tools.
name: Glean

description: Glide is a no-code app builder that transforms Google Sheets, Excel, or Airtable data into a polished mobile or web app in minutes. Its AI assistant can generate app structures from a description of your workflow, and apps update in real time as the underlying spreadsheet changes. Operations teams and field workers use Glide to build internal tools without waiting for engineering resources.
name: Glide

description: Gong is an AI revenue intelligence platform that records and analyses every customer call, email, and demo to surface patterns that separate winning deals from lost ones. Its machine-learning models highlight moments where reps go off-script, flag at-risk deals based on conversation signals, and coach individuals with clip-based feedback. Sales leaders at growth-stage and enterprise companies use Gong to systematise what their best reps do.
name: Gong

description: Google AI Studio is the free, browser-based IDE for experimenting with and building on Gemini models. Developers can test prompts across Gemini Pro, Gemini Flash, and experimental models; build multi-turn chatbots; and generate API keys for use in applications — all without a credit card. It supports multimodal inputs including images, video, audio, and documents, and its million-token context window can be tested interactively. AI Studio is typically the first place developers try Gemini, and it provides a direct export to Vertex AI for production deployments.
name: Google AI Studio

description: Google Assistant is Google's AI voice assistant, available on Android phones, smart speakers, smart displays, and Nest devices. It understands natural-language commands for setting reminders, answering questions, controlling smart home devices, and managing your Google calendar. It's gradually being superseded by Gemini on newer Android devices as Google migrates its AI experiences.
name: Google Assistant

description: Jules is Google's AI coding agent that works asynchronously on your GitHub repository. You assign Jules a task — fix this bug, implement this feature, add tests — and it independently reads the codebase, writes a plan, makes changes across multiple files, and opens a pull request. Unlike interactive coding assistants, Jules operates in the background while you continue other work, returning with a completed PR to review. Powered by Gemini 2.0, it is Google's direct answer to GitHub Copilot Workspace and Devin.
name: Google Jules

description: Google Maps is the world's most widely used navigation and local discovery platform, trusted by over 1 billion monthly users. Its AI continuously updates routing based on real-time traffic data, surfaces personalised business recommendations, and powers Street View's visual search. For businesses, a Google Maps listing is often the first place a local customer encounters your brand.
name: Google Maps

description: Google Translate is a free AI translation service supporting 133 languages, available on the web, as a mobile app, and as an API. It offers instant camera translation of signs and menus, conversation mode for real-time spoken translation, and a document translation feature that preserves formatting. Despite newer competitors, it remains the go-to for quick, accessible translation worldwide.
name: Google Translate

description: Gorgias is a customer support platform built specifically for e-commerce, integrating deeply with Shopify, Magento, and BigCommerce to give support agents instant access to order data, subscriptions, and customer history. Its AI features auto-respond to common questions like 'where is my order?', suggest replies based on past conversations, and route tickets by intent and urgency. Over 14,000 DTC brands use Gorgias to manage customer support across email, chat, social media, and SMS from a single unified inbox.
name: Gorgias

description: GPT Engineer (now Lovable's predecessor, continuing as gptengineer.app) was one of the first tools to demonstrate AI generating a complete, runnable codebase from a single natural language specification. The user describes what they want to build, the AI asks clarifying questions, then generates all the files and code needed. Its open-source roots spawned a large community and influenced a generation of AI coding tools. The project continues as a web app and CLI tool for developers who prefer a more raw, configuration-driven approach to AI-generated projects.
name: GPT Engineer

description: GPT-4o is OpenAI's flagship model — an omni model that natively understands and generates text, images, audio, and code in a single unified architecture. It's faster and cheaper than GPT-4 Turbo while matching or exceeding its performance, and it powers the free tier of ChatGPT. Alongside GPT-4o, OpenAI offers o3 and o1 reasoning models for tasks requiring deep multi-step thinking, making the OpenAI API family the most widely deployed in the industry.
name: GPT-4o

description: Grain is an AI meeting recorder and conversation intelligence tool for sales teams. It automatically clips the most important moments from recorded calls, adds AI-generated summaries, and pushes key data to your CRM with a single click. Deal coaches use Grain's highlight reels to train reps on what good discovery and objection handling look like.
name: Grain

description: Grammarly is the most widely used AI writing assistant, checking grammar, spelling, punctuation, clarity, and tone across emails, documents, and web browsers. Its premium tier offers full-sentence rewrites, plagiarism detection, and a generative AI assistant that can draft text from scratch. Over 40 million people and 50,000 teams use Grammarly to write with more confidence and fewer errors.
name: Grammarly

description: Granular is an enterprise farm management platform that helps large agricultural operations plan, execute, and analyse every aspect of their business — from field-level agronomics to financial reporting. Its AI tools forecast input costs, track crop performance against benchmarks, and identify the most profitable fields and practices. It's built for the complexity of farms running hundreds or thousands of acres.
name: Granular

description: Greenhouse is a structured hiring platform used by high-growth companies to run consistent, data-driven recruiting processes. Its AI tools assist with job description writing, candidate scoring, interview scheduling automation, and diversity analytics. Companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, and Squarespace use Greenhouse to reduce bias and improve the quality and speed of every hire.
name: Greenhouse

description: Groq delivers the fastest publicly available LLM inference on the market, running Llama, Mixtral, Gemma, and other open models at speeds exceeding 500 tokens per second — typically 10–20× faster than GPU-based cloud providers. This is achieved through Groq's custom Language Processing Unit (LPU) chips, designed specifically for sequential token generation. Developers use Groq's API as a drop-in OpenAI replacement wherever response latency matters most, from real-time voice applications to low-latency agentic pipelines.
name: Groq

description: H2O.ai is an open-source machine learning platform that makes it fast to build and deploy predictive models at scale. Its AutoML capabilities automatically explore dozens of algorithms and select the best performer for your dataset — no ML expertise required. Data science teams in banking, insurance, and healthcare use H2O.ai to put production-grade models into operation quickly.
name: H2O.ai

description: Happy Scribe is an AI transcription and subtitle platform that converts audio and video into accurate text in 60+ languages. It offers both automated transcription and a human proofreading service for higher-stakes content, along with a subtitle editor and direct export to SRT, VTT, and other formats. Journalists, researchers, and video teams use it to make their content searchable and accessible.
name: Happy Scribe

description: Harvey is an AI platform built specifically for law firms and legal departments, combining large language models with deep domain expertise in law. It can draft contracts, perform due diligence review, research case law, and analyse regulatory documents — all within a secure, confidential environment. Global law firms including Allen & Overy and PwC Legal have deployed Harvey at scale.
name: Harvey

description: Hatchful is Shopify's free AI logo generator that produces a customisable logo for any business in seconds. You select your industry, choose a style direction, and Hatchful generates dozens of logo options complete with colour variants and social media-ready files. It's the lowest-friction entry point for entrepreneurs who need a visual identity before their first sale.
name: Hatchful

description: Height is an AI-first project management tool where the AI assistant actively participates in your workflow — automatically triaging tickets, writing subtasks, updating statuses, and generating summaries of where a project stands. Unlike traditional PM tools that bolt AI on as a feature, Height's AI is designed to run in the background handling routine management work autonomously.
name: Height

description: HeyGen is an AI video creation platform that lets you produce professional presenter videos with AI avatars that speak any script in 40+ languages. You can clone your own voice and likeness or choose from over 100 pre-built avatars, making HeyGen popular for corporate training, product demos, and multilingual content at scale. Its lip-sync quality is considered among the best in the industry.
name: HeyGen

description: Homestyler is a free AI-powered interior design and 3D home planning tool used by millions of homeowners and designers. You scan a room with your phone or draw it from scratch, then drag and drop real furniture from brand catalogues to visualise a redesign before spending any money. Its community of over 50 million projects makes it one of the world's largest interior design platforms.
name: Homestyler

description: Hootsuite is a social media management platform that lets teams schedule content, monitor brand mentions, and analyse performance across all major social networks from one dashboard. Its AI-powered OwlyWriter generates captions and post ideas on demand, and bulk scheduling lets teams plan an entire month of content in an hour. It's the choice of enterprise brands managing multiple accounts and markets.
name: Hootsuite

description: Houzz is an online platform for home renovation and design, combining a product marketplace, a directory of professionals, and a photo ideabook with over 21 million curated images. Its AI-powered Shop the Look feature identifies furniture and decor in inspiration photos and links them to buyable products. Homeowners use it to plan every aspect of a renovation and find vetted contractors.
name: Houzz

description: HubSpot is a leading CRM platform that unifies marketing, sales, and customer service with AI running through every product. Its AI features include content generation, lead scoring, email subject line optimisation, chatbots, and a conversational intelligence layer across calls and deals. Over 205,000 companies use HubSpot as their core go-to-market system, from funded startups to enterprise brands.
name: HubSpot

description: HubSpot is a leading CRM platform that unifies marketing, sales, and customer service with AI running through every product. Its AI features include content generation, lead scoring, email subject line optimisation, chatbots, and a conversational intelligence layer across calls and deals. Over 205,000 companies use HubSpot as their core go-to-market system, from funded startups to enterprise brands.
name: HubSpot

description: HubSpot CRM is HubSpot's free customer relationship management system that tracks contacts, deals, and communications across the entire customer lifecycle. Its AI-powered features score leads, predict deal close probability, and suggest follow-up actions for every open opportunity. It integrates seamlessly with Gmail, Outlook, and the full HubSpot marketing and sales suite.
name: HubSpot CRM

description: Hugging Face is the central hub of the open-source AI ecosystem — hosting over 900,000 models, 200,000 datasets, and 300,000 interactive demo Spaces. It provides the Transformers library, the Inference API, and a social platform where researchers share new models the day they drop. From BERT and Stable Diffusion to Llama and Mistral, virtually every major open model ships to Hugging Face first, making it the essential destination for anyone working with or exploring AI.
name: Hugging Face

description: Hume AI builds AI that can understand and express emotion. Its Empathic Voice Interface (EVI) is a voice AI that reads vocal cues — tone, pace, inflection — to gauge how the user is feeling and adapt its responses accordingly, producing the most naturalistic AI voice conversations available. EVI 2 adds expressive emotional output, laughing, sighing, and varying its energy to match the conversation. Hume's APIs are used in mental health applications, educational tools, and consumer apps where emotional intelligence matters.
name: Hume AI

description: Hunter is an email outreach tool that finds professional email addresses associated with any company domain. It searches the web for publicly available contact information and verifies deliverability so your outreach doesn't bounce. Marketing teams, recruiters, and business development professionals use Hunter to build prospect lists and verify emails before campaigns launch.
name: Hunter

description: IBM Watson Government is a suite of AI services tailored to the security, compliance, and interoperability requirements of federal and state agencies. It covers natural language processing, computer vision, data analytics, and decision automation — all deployable on IBM Cloud, AWS GovCloud, or on-premises. Agencies use it for citizen services, fraud detection, procurement optimisation, and intelligence analysis.
name: IBM Watson Government

description: Imgflip is one of the web's most popular meme creation sites, offering thousands of templates and an AI meme generator that writes captions automatically. You search a template, enter a topic or mood, and the AI generates punchy meme text in seconds. With over 200 million monthly visitors, Imgflip has become a primary destination for internet culture and meme discovery.
name: Imgflip

description: Indeed is the world's largest job site, aggregating listings from thousands of sources alongside jobs posted directly on the platform. Its AI matching engine surfaces relevant openings based on your resume, search history, and stated preferences, and sends proactive job alerts. Employers use Indeed Sponsored Jobs and AI-assisted screening to get qualified candidates in front of hiring managers faster.
name: Indeed

description: Infogram is a data visualisation and infographic tool designed for communicators who need clear, visual storytelling from complex data. Its AI suggests chart types based on your data structure and a smart layout engine keeps visuals consistent and professional. Journalists, marketers, and educators use it to turn spreadsheets into shareable, interactive graphics.
name: Infogram

description: Intercom is a customer communications platform that combines live chat, AI-powered bots, email campaigns, and a help centre in one system. Its Fin AI agent handles a large proportion of support questions autonomously, escalating only complex cases to human agents. Product-led growth companies use Intercom to convert trial users, onboard customers, and reduce churn through proactive in-app messaging.
name: Intercom

description: InVideo is an AI-powered video creation platform that turns text, scripts, or blog posts into professional videos using stock footage, AI voiceover, and automated editing. Its library of 5,000+ templates covers ads, explainers, social content, and news formats. Marketers and content teams use InVideo to produce video content at scale without needing video editing skills.
name: InVideo

description: Inworld AI is a platform for creating intelligent, emotionally expressive NPCs (non-player characters) for games and virtual worlds. Its character engine gives each NPC a unique personality, memory, and conversational ability so players have genuinely dynamic interactions rather than scripted dialogue trees. Game studios integrate Inworld via Unity and Unreal Engine SDK to add AI depth to their worlds.
name: Inworld AI

description: Jan is an open-source, privacy-first desktop application for running AI models entirely on your own machine. It supports GGUF models from Hugging Face, provides a clean ChatGPT-style interface, and exposes a local API server compatible with the OpenAI format. name: Kensho

Its Khanmigo AI tutor — powered by GPT-4 — guides students through problems with Socratic questioning rather than just giving answers. Over 150 million people have used Khan Academy to learn at their own pace, anywhere in the world.
name: Khan Academy

Its library of 35+ ATS-friendly templates is designed to pass automated screening systems, and a built-in resume checker highlights weaknesses before you submit. Job seekers at all career stages use it to cut application time while improving quality.
name: Kickresume

description: Kimi is an AI assistant from Chinese startup Moonshot AI, notable for having one of the largest context windows available — up to 1 million tokens — allowing it to read entire books, massive codebases, or years of documents in a single prompt. Its reasoning model Kimi k1.5 has achieved top scores on international benchmarks including AIME and MATH, competing directly with OpenAI o1 and DeepSeek R1. Kimi is available in both Chinese and English and has attracted tens of millions of users.
name: Kimi

description: Krisp uses AI to remove background noise and echo in real time during calls and recordings, regardless of which conferencing app you use. It works as a virtual audio device that sits between your microphone and any calling software — Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, Discord — and strips out keyboard clicks, barking dogs, construction noise, and room echo. Used by remote workers, podcasters, and customer support teams, Krisp also offers AI meeting transcription and meeting notes.
name: Krisp

description: LangChain is the most widely adopted open-source framework for building applications powered by large language models. It provides modular components for chaining prompts, connecting LLMs to external data sources, memory systems, and tool-use APIs. Developers use LangChain as the scaffolding for AI assistants, autonomous agents, document Q&A systems, and complex multi-step pipelines.
name: LangChain

description: Langflow is a visual, open-source platform for building LangChain applications through a drag-and-drop canvas. Each LangChain component — LLMs, prompts, agents, tools, vector stores, document loaders — is a node that can be wired together and tested in real time. It makes complex RAG systems, multi-agent workflows, and chatbots accessible to developers without deep LangChain expertise. Langflow can be self-hosted or run in the cloud via DataStax Astra, and it exports deployable Python code from any workflow.
name: Langflow

description: LanguageTool is an open-source grammar, style, and spell checker that supports over 30 languages — far more than its competitors. Its browser extension and desktop app check writing in real time across any website or application, catching grammar errors, awkward phrasing, redundancies, and register mismatches. Unlike Grammarly, it can be self-hosted for privacy-sensitive environments, making it popular in European enterprises with strict data governance requirements. Its premium tier adds an AI-powered rephrasing assistant for clearer, more concise writing.
name: LanguageTool

description: Later is a social media scheduling and analytics platform focused on visual content for Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, and other image-forward channels. Its AI caption writer and hashtag suggester streamline post creation, and a visual content calendar lets teams plan their feed aesthetics a month in advance. Creators and brand teams use Later to keep a consistent posting cadence without daily manual effort.
name: Later

description: LawGeex is an AI contract review platform that analyses contracts against a company's pre-approved legal playbook and flags deviations in minutes. It handles non-disclosure agreements, vendor contracts, and other standard documents — tasks that typically consume hours of paralegal and lawyer time. Legal and procurement teams use it to increase review throughput while maintaining consistent standards.
name: LawGeex

description: Le Chat is Mistral AI's consumer-facing chat assistant, providing free access to Mistral's latest models including Mistral Large, Pixtral, and the Mistral reasoning models. Its web search feature retrieves live information, and its canvas mode lets users collaborate on documents and code in a side panel. Le Chat is particularly fast — Mistral's custom inference infrastructure delivers responses significantly quicker than ChatGPT — and its generous free tier has attracted users looking for a capable, uncensored European AI alternative to OpenAI.
name: Le Chat

description: Linear is a fast, opinionated project and issue tracking tool built for software teams that want minimal friction between an idea and a shipped feature. Its AI features write issue descriptions from context, auto-triage incoming bugs, and generate weekly project summaries. Engineering teams at high-growth startups and scale-ups prefer Linear's speed and keyboard-first design over heavier tools like Jira.
name: Linear

description: LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, used by over 1 billion members for job searching, hiring, business development, and professional content. Its AI features write InMail drafts, optimise profiles for recruiter search, and personalise the job feed to your career trajectory. Virtually every business professional maintains a LinkedIn presence, making it the default B2B social platform.
name: LinkedIn

description: LinkedIn Sales Navigator is the premium B2B prospecting tool that sits on top of LinkedIn's 950+ million member network. AI-powered lead recommendations surface contacts that match your ideal customer profile, and InMail credits let you reach anyone outside your network. Enterprise sales teams use it as their primary source of account intelligence and warm outreach.
name: LinkedIn Sales Navigator

description: Llama 4 is Meta's latest generation of open-weight large language models, featuring a Mixture-of-Experts architecture that achieves frontier-level capability while remaining freely downloadable under Meta's community licence. The family spans Scout (17B active parameters, 10M-token context), Maverick (17B active, multimodal), and Behemoth (288B active, teacher model) variants. Its open nature makes it the most widely self-hosted and fine-tuned LLM family, deployed in production across research labs, enterprises, and consumer applications worldwide.
name: Llama 4

description: Llamasoft (acquired by Coupa) is an AI platform for strategic supply chain design and network optimisation. Global manufacturers and retailers use Llamasoft to stress-test their supply chains before committing capital.

description: LM Studio is a desktop application for Mac, Windows, and Linux that lets anyone browse, download, and run open-source language models locally without touching the command line. It supports the full range of GGUF-quantised models from Hugging Face, making state-of-the-art AI accessible on consumer laptops.

name: Manus

It exposes a local REST API compatible with the OpenAI format, so any application built for GPT can be pointed at a local model instead. Privacy-conscious developers, researchers without cloud budgets, and anyone wanting offline AI capability have made Ollama one of the fastest-growing tools in the AI ecosystem.

description: Open WebUI (formerly Ollama WebUI) is an open-source, self-hosted web interface that brings a polished ChatGPT-like experience to local AI models running via Ollama, LM Studio, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. IT teams and AI enthusiasts deploy it on their own servers to give their organisation a private, self-hosted AI assistant with no data leaving their infrastructure.

Launched in early 2025, Operator represents OpenAI's push into the agentic AI space where AI doesn't just answer questions but actively accomplishes goals. It is available to ChatGPT Pro subscribers and being expanded to other tiers.
name: OpenAI Operator

description: OpenAI's Realtime API enables direct, low-latency speech-to-speech conversations with GPT-4o, without the latency of a traditional transcription → LLM → TTS pipeline. Applications built on it can respond to voice in under 300ms, support natural interruptions mid-sentence, and detect tone and emotion in the speaker's voice. It's become the standard way to build model-agnostic applications and to access models that aren't otherwise available via direct API.

Researchers, educators, and content creators use Pages to quickly produce well-sourced reference documents on any topic, with the AI handling research, writing, and citation formatting simultaneously.
name: Perplexity Pages

description: Perplexity Sonar is the API that gives developers access to Perplexity's real-time, search-augmented AI. Unlike standard LLM APIs that are limited to training data, Sonar retrieves up-to-date information from the web and returns answers with citations. It's used to add live search grounding to AI applications without building a web search pipeline from scratch. The Sonar Pro model handles complex, multi-step research queries, while Sonar and Sonar Turbo target high-volume use cases where speed and cost efficiency matter.

description: Pinecone is the most widely used managed vector database, providing the long-term memory infrastructure for AI applications. When building a RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) system, embeddings are stored in Pinecone and retrieved by semantic similarity at query time — giving LLMs access to private knowledge without fine-tuning. Its serverless tier makes it free to start, while its managed service scales to billions of vectors for enterprise applications. Pinecone is a foundational component in the majority of production AI applications built in 2024–2025.
name: Pinecone

description: Pipedrive is a sales-focused CRM designed to keep deal pipeline visible and moving forward. name: Pipedrive

Startups and agencies use Pitch to create investor decks and client presentations that stand out.
name: Pitch

Over 8,000 applications use Plaid to move money and access financial data.
name: Plaid

Governments, NGOs, and businesses use Planet data to monitor climate commitments, manage supply chain risk, and respond to humanitarian crises.
name: Planet Labs

Homeowners and interior designers use it to visualise renovations and communicate design intent to contractors.
name: Planner 5D

name: PlantNet

It's the BI tool of choice at organisations already standardised on Microsoft products.
name: Power BI

name: Productivity Directory

Production teams at game studios and virtual production houses use it to assemble environments in hours rather than days.
name: Promethean AI

Its AI rephrasing suggestions and genre-specific style checks make it particularly strong for long-form writing.
name: ProWritingAid

It has become the productivity launcher of choice for many Mac-based developers and designers.
name: Raycast AI

Video creators, archivists, and photographers use it to restore or enhance footage that was captured at insufficient resolution.

name: RemNote

Life sciences, energy, and deep tech companies use Iris.ai to accelerate the earliest stages of innovation.
name: Iris.ai

description: JetBrains AI Assistant integrates AI-powered code completion, generation, explanation, and refactoring directly into the full JetBrains IDE family — IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, and more. JetBrains users prefer it over standalone tools because it works inside the IDE they already live in.
name: JetBrains AI Assistant

description: Julius AI is a conversational data analysis tool that connects to spreadsheets, databases, and CSV files and lets you ask questions in plain English — producing charts, statistical summaries, and Python-generated insights without writing code. Analysts, marketers, and researchers who work with data but aren't fluent in Python or SQL use Julius to move from raw data to insight in minutes.
name: Julius AI

Designers use it to break out of default colour habits and discover combinations they wouldn't have thought to try manually.
name: Khroma

description: Kindroid is an AI companion app focused on building a persistent, deeply personalised relationship with an AI character you define — with long-term memory, a custom backstory, and consistent personality across conversations. Users seeking a thoughtful, relationship-oriented AI experience choose Kindroid over more entertainment-focused alternatives.
name: Kindroid

description: Kling AI is a text-to-video and image-to-video generation platform from Kuaishou, known for producing smooth, physically realistic video clips up to two minutes long. Filmmakers, advertisers, and social media creators use Kling to generate cinematic footage that would otherwise require expensive production.
name: Kling AI

description: Kokoro is a lightweight open-source text-to-speech model known for producing natural, high-quality speech that punches well above its model size. It supports multiple voices and has been widely adopted in the open-source AI community.
name: Kokoro TTS

description: Krea AI is a creative platform focused on real-time AI generation — you see images update live as you type or draw, enabling an intuitive visual exploration process. Its upscaler, enhancer, and style-transfer tools let creators refine AI-generated and real photographs with exceptional quality. Designers and visual artists use Krea for its unique real-time feedback loop that makes iterating on visual ideas feel like sketching.
name: Krea AI

description: Lavender is an AI email assistant that scores your cold emails in real time and explains exactly what to change to increase reply rates — flagging sentences that are too long, openers that sound generic, and missing personalisation. SDRs and sales reps at B2B companies use Lavender to improve email quality and book more meetings from the same number of sends.
name: Lavender

description: Leonardo AI is a generative AI platform focused on creative and game-development use cases, offering fine-tuned models for characters, environments, concept art, and product visuals. Game developers and concept artists use it to produce consistent, high-volume visual assets.
name: Leonardo AI

description: Litmaps is a literature discovery tool that visualises a researcher's reading list as an interactive citation map, automatically finding related papers and alerting users when new relevant work is published. PhD students and researchers use Litmaps to maintain awareness of a field's development without manually monitoring dozens of journals.
name: Litmaps

description: LlamaIndex is an open-source data framework for connecting large language models to external data sources — databases, PDFs, APIs, Notion, Slack — to build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications and AI agents that reason over private data. Developers building document Q&A, knowledge bases, and enterprise AI assistants use LlamaIndex as the data layer.
name: LlamaIndex

description: Logseq is an open-source, privacy-first knowledge management tool based on a local-first outliner and graph database that links blocks and pages into a connected knowledge graph. Researchers and developers favour Logseq for its Git-friendly plain-text storage and powerful query language that turns a personal knowledge base into a queryable database.
name: Logseq

description: Lovable is an AI-powered web app builder that turns a text description into a fully functional, deployable application — handling React frontend, Supabase backend, and authentication in one flow. name: Lovable

Creatives and agencies use it to produce high-quality video concepts and b-roll footage without a camera crew.
name: Luma Dream Machine

description: Luminar Neo is a desktop photo editing application from Skylum that uses AI to automate complex retouching tasks — sky replacement, portrait enhancement, object removal, and relighting — that would take hours in Photoshop. name: Luminar Neo

description: Mem is an AI note-taking app that automatically organises your notes by detecting topics, people, and projects — so you never have to manually file anything. name: Mem

description: Meshy is an AI 3D generation platform that converts text descriptions or reference images into fully textured, production-ready 3D models in minutes. Game developers, product designers, and XR creators use Meshy to dramatically cut the cost and time of 3D asset production.
name: Meshy

description: Microsoft Copilot is the AI assistant integrated throughout Microsoft's product ecosystem — Windows, Edge, Bing, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and Outlook. Powered by GPT-4o and Bing's real-time search index, it drafts documents, analyses spreadsheets, summarises emails, generates images, and answers questions across all Microsoft 365 apps. For the hundreds of millions of Microsoft 365 users, Copilot is the AI assistant with the deepest integration into their existing workflow.
name: Microsoft Copilot

description: Mistral AI is a French AI company that has rapidly established itself as the leading European alternative to OpenAI, producing a family of models — Mistral 7B, Mixtral, Mistral Large — known for strong performance at smaller sizes and permissive open-weight licences. Its Le Chat assistant is available for direct use, while its API powers thousands of developer applications. Enterprises choosing European AI for compliance and data sovereignty reasons frequently standardise on Mistral.
name: Mistral AI

description: Mubert is a generative AI music platform that streams infinitely long, non-repetitive music tailored to a mood or activity — and offers an API for developers to integrate adaptive background music into apps and games. Its Render tool lets creators generate tracks for content with specific duration and energy requirements. Developers and content platforms embed Mubert to provide dynamic, contextual audio without licensing complex libraries.
name: Mubert

description: NightCafe Studio is one of the longest-running AI art platforms, offering access to multiple generation models — Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, and proprietary models — through a credit-based web interface. Its built-in community allows creators to share, comment, and collaborate on AI art, and daily challenges keep the community engaged. It's a popular starting point for people exploring AI art who want variety and a supportive community without technical setup.
name: NightCafe Studio

description: NotebookLM is Google's AI-powered research tool that lets you upload documents, PDFs, and notes and then ask questions, get summaries, and generate study guides entirely grounded in your source material. Its Audio Overview feature transforms a document collection into a conversational podcast-style discussion. Researchers, students, and analysts use it to synthesise knowledge from large document sets without risking hallucinated facts.
name: NotebookLM

description: Notion AI brings generative AI capabilities directly into Notion workspaces, enabling users to draft documents, summarize pages, translate content, and extract action items from meeting notes without leaving their workspace. It can autofill database properties, generate structured content from prompts, and ask questions across your entire Notion workspace using Q&A mode. Teams use it to accelerate documentation, wikis, and project planning while keeping all knowledge centralized.
name: Notion AI

description: NovelAI is a subscription platform for AI-assisted creative writing and image generation, focused on anime-style art and interactive narrative fiction. Writers and artists in the anime and light-novel community use it as an all-in-one creative sandbox.
name: NovelAI

name: Obsidian AI

Operations managers and business analysts use it to add AI-driven forecasting to workflows that previously required a data scientist.
name: Obviously AI

name: OpenAI o3

name: Pipedream

name: PlayHT

name: Ramp

Sales teams and managers use the engagement data to coach reps and improve how meetings run.
name: Read AI

Writers and knowledge workers use Reflect to build a second brain that actively surfaces relevant past thinking.

name: Remove.bg
